title: Dynamic investment in disaster preparedness under recurrent and catastrophic risks
abstract: arXiv:2611.00673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term disaster risk reduction (DRR) requires investment decisions that account for uncertain disaster conditions and accumulated preparedness capacity. This study develops a novel stochastic dynamic control model for optimal DRR investment under recurrent and catastrophic uncertainty. The model combines diffusion and Poisson jump processes and treats preparedness capital as an endogenous stock that accumulates through investment, depreciates, and mitigates economic damage. We derive a state-dependent investment rule from the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation to minimize expected discounted investment expenditure and disaster damage over an infinite horizon.   Monte Carlo policy comparisons and numerical experiments examine how disaster risk structures interact with investment decisions to shape preparedness accumulation and economic losses. translated_title: 复发性与灾难性风险下灾害防范能力的动态投资
translated_abstract: 长期的灾害风险减轻（DRR）需要能够考虑不确定灾害条件和累积防范能力的投资决策。本研究开发了一个新颖的随机动态控制模型，用于在复发性与灾难性不确定性下进行最优的灾害风险减轻投资。该模型结合了扩散过程和泊松跳跃过程，并将防范资本视为一种内生存量，它通过投资而累积、随时间折旧，并能减轻经济损失。作者从Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程推导出状态依赖的投资规则，以在无限期内最小化期望折现投资支出与灾害损失的总和。蒙特卡洛政策比较和数值实验考察了灾害风险结构如何与投资决策相互作用，进而塑造防范能力的积累和经济损失。结果表明，灾害风险减轻投资的经济价值取决于对不断演变的风险环境的调整适应。
tldr: 本研究提出一个结合扩散与泊松跳跃过程的随机动态控制模型，通过求解HJB方程得到状态依赖的最优灾害防范投资规则，揭示了不同灾害风险结构如何影响防范资本积累与经济损失。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a stochastic dynamic control model combining diffusion and Poisson jump processes, derives a state-dependent optimal investment rule via the HJB equation, and shows how disaster risk structures shape preparedness capital accumulation and economic losses.
